paper.title: X-Tokenizer: A Multimodal Action Tokenizer for Vision-Language-Action Pretraining
paper.abstract: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models must bridge pretrained vision-language reasoning and precise continuous robot control. Existing action tokenizers discretize actions primarily for reconstruction, producing codes that preserve motion geometry but provide only weak semantic supervision to the backbone. We therefore formulate action tokenization not as mere compression, but as semantic interface learning between multimodal reasoning and executable control. To this end, we introduce X-Toke

summary.core_problem: 为 Vision-Language-Action 预训练设计一种动作 tokenizer，使连续机器人控制既能被离散建模，又能向 VLA backbone 提供语义监督。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是跨模态 tokenization 和统一预训练接口设计。它把动作离散化从“重建压缩”改成“语义接口学习”，对把机器人动作、视觉和语言放进同一个 LM/VLM 训练空间有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 X-Tokenizer，一个轻量 encoder-Semantic Residual Quantization-decoder 架构。SRQ 对残差向量量化做非对称设计：第一层用 Masked Action Modeling 训练，形成表示粗粒度运动意图的离散动作语言；更深层保留重建导向的 residual code，用于保存精细控制细节。整体目标是在多种机械臂 embodiment 间共享动作接口。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供完整实验细节、模型规模、机器人数据规模、baseline 或数值提升。可确认的实验目标是评估该 tokenizer 在多样机械臂动作上的共享表达、语义对齐和重建控制能力。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper designs an action tokenizer for Vision-Language-Action pretraining, aiming to bridge pretrained multimodal reasoning and continuous robot control.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a tokenization interface for unified multimodal-action pretraining. The key shift is treating action discretization as semantic interface learning rather than pure reconstruction.
summary_en.technical_approach: X-Tokenizer uses a lightweight encoder-Semantic Residual Quantization-decoder design. SRQ makes residual quantization asymmetric: the first level is trained with Masked Action Modeling to capture coarse motion intent as a discrete action language, while deeper levels remain reconstruction-oriented residual codes for fine-grained control.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract does not include model size, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The evaluation appears to target shared action representation, semantic alignment, and reconstruction quality across robotic-arm embodiments.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 SRQ 设计；它把动作 token 的第一层变成语义码，而不是只追求重建误差。
recommendation.en: Skim the SRQ design; the useful idea is making the first action-code level semantic rather than purely reconstructive.

paper.title: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in learning generalist robot policies from large-scale multimodal data. However, most existing VLA systems are trained and evaluated primarily with English instructions, leaving their ability to understand and execute instructions in other languages largely unexplored. While the underlying large language models often possess multilingual capabilities, it remains unclear whether these multilingual capabilities transfe

summary.core_problem: Vision-Language-Action 模型多数用英语指令训练和评估，尚不清楚底层 LLM 的多语言能力是否能迁移到机器人动作策略中。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLA 多语言能力的系统评估。它指出 native multimodal / action 训练可能损伤或遮蔽 LLM backbone 原有的跨语言能力；对多模态统一预训练有旁证价值，但机器人任务本身离文本基座训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 将现有 VLA benchmark 的英语指令翻译成多语言版本，并在仿真任务中评估多个代表性 VLA 模型。核心是 controlled instruction translation + cross-language performance comparison，用来测量英语训练模型在非英语指令下的执行退化。
summary.experiments: 摘要称覆盖多个代表性 VLA 模型和一系列仿真任务，发现主要用英语训练的模型存在显著 multilingual gap：即便底层 LLM 具备多语言能力，VLA 训练后也不能可靠迁移到非英语指令执行。具体模型列表、语言覆盖和退化幅度需看正文。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Beijing Jiaotong University。

summary_en.core_problem: Most Vision-Language-Action models are trained and evaluated with English instructions, and it is unclear whether the multilingual ability of the underlying LLM transfers to robotic action policies.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systematic evaluation of multilingual VLA behavior. It suggests that native multimodal and action training can damage or obscure the cross-lingual abilities of the LLM backbone. This is relevant as indirect evidence for multimodal pretraining, though the robotics setting is not central to text foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper extends existing VLA benchmarks by translating English instructions into multiple languages, then evaluates representative VLA models in simulation. The core setup is controlled instruction translation plus cross-language performance comparison to measure degradation under non-English instructions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluation across several representative VLA models and simulation tasks. Models trained mainly on English show a substantial multilingual gap: multilingual capability in the LLM backbone does not reliably transfer to non-English instruction execution after VLA training. Exact model names, language coverage, and degradation numbers require the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Beijing Jiaotong University.

recommendation.zh: 知道这个 failure mode 即可；若做多模态预训练，只需看语言退化表，不必深读机器人细节。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a failure mode; for multimodal pretraining, read the language-degradation table and skip most robotics details.

paper.title: $μ_0$: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
paper.abstract: World models that capture how actions induce physical change enable scalable robot learning without reliance on embodiment-specific action labels. Pixel-space video models provide broad visual priors but expend model capacity on dense appearance reconstruction, while direct action models require embodiment-specific labels that hinder scalability. We present $μ_0$, a scalable world model based on 3D traces. Rather than predicting dense pixels or directly modeling actions, $μ_0$ forecasts smooth 3

summary.core_problem: 用可扩展、与具体机器人形态无关的方式建模交互视频中的物理变化，而不是直接预测像素或依赖特定机器人动作标签。
summary.importance: 贡献点在于把机器人世界模型的监督从 dense video reconstruction 转向稀疏 3D interaction traces。对 LLM 预训练研究员的间接价值是：它提供了一种把视频交互压缩成可语言对齐、可预测的中间表示的思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 μ0，以显著交互点的平滑 3D 轨迹作为动作诱发变化的表示。TraceExtract 自动从多源视频中选择关键点、构建全局对齐轨迹，并把运动片段与层级语言 caption 关联；模型侧结合预训练视觉语言 backbone 与 trace 预测头进行预训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整参数量、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度。实验重点应是跨视频来源提取 3D trace supervision，并验证 trace 预测相较像素预测或直接动作建模在机器人交互建模上的泛化性。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Jia-Bin Huang 和 Furong Huang；两位分别在视觉生成/视频理解和机器学习基础方法上有较多代表性工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to model action-induced physical change in interaction videos without dense pixel prediction or embodiment-specific action labels.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a representation shift for robotic world models: supervise prediction through sparse 3D interaction traces rather than full video reconstruction. For pretraining researchers, the relevant signal is the compression of embodied video into language-aligned, predictable intermediate state variables.
summary_en.technical_approach: μ0 predicts smooth 3D trajectories for salient interaction points such as objects, tools, hands, and contact regions. TraceExtract automatically selects keypoints, builds globally aligned traces, and associates motion segments with hierarchical language captions; the model combines a pretrained vision-language backbone with trace forecasting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, or numerical gains. The experiments appear to focus on extracting 3D trace supervision from diverse videos and testing whether trace prediction generalizes better than pixel-space or direct-action modeling for embodied interaction.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jia-Bin Huang and Furong Huang, both known for work in visual generative modeling, video understanding, and foundational machine learning methods.

recommendation.zh: 不必精读，但 trace 作为视频交互 tokenizer 的设定值得记下；看方法图和 TraceExtract 流程即可。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper to read deeply, but the trace-as-interaction-tokenizer idea is worth noting; inspect the method figure and TraceExtract pipeline.

paper.title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
paper.abstract: World action models (WAMs) have recently shown promise in jointly modeling future observations and executable robot actions. However, most existing WAMs still operate in 2D video or latent spaces, where visually plausible rollouts miss the 3D spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry required for precise manipulation. While geometric foundation models offer strong priors for recovering dense 3D structure and motion from visual observations, forcing WAMs to predict the dense 4D representa

summary.core_problem: 在机器人 world action model 中同时建模未来观测和可执行动作，但避免密集 4D 几何预测带来的慢速推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 embodied world model 的架构和训练设计。它不是 LLM 基座预训练核心论文，但 spatial register tokens、训练期几何读出、推理期移除分支的设计，对多模态世界模型和 action-conditioned transformer 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WAM4D，用轻量 spatial register tokens 作为训练期 future-depth readout，把预训练几何模型的 3D/4D 先验迁移到因果 video-action transformer 中；推理时移除 register 分支，以降低动作生成开销。论文还设计 causal mixture attention，用于 Mixture-of-Transformers，避免模型通过非因果几何分支偷看未来信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是比密集 4D 表示预测更快地生成可执行动作，并保持空间约束和遮挡接触几何信息。给定信息未包含模型参数量、训练数据规模、机器人任务集合、baseline 名单或数值结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表包含 Jian Tang；机构信息无法从给定摘要确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to model future observations and executable robot actions in a world action model while avoiding the inference cost of dense 4D geometry prediction.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an architecture and training design for embodied world models. It is not a core LLM pretraining paper, but the idea of training-time spatial register tokens and inference-time branch removal is relevant to multimodal world models and action-conditioned transformers.
summary_en.technical_approach: WAM4D uses lightweight spatial register tokens as training-time future-depth readouts to transfer priors from pretrained geometric models into a causal video-action transformer. The register branch is removed at inference for faster action generation. Causal mixture attention is introduced for the Mixture-of-Transformers setup to prevent non-causal shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames WAM4D as faster than dense 4D prediction while preserving spatial constraints and occluded contact geometry. The provided information does not include parameter count, training data scale, robot task suite, baselines, or numerical results.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Jian Tang; affiliations are not confirmed from the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 technical design：训练期 register 蒸馏几何先验、推理期删分支，这个取舍对 embodied pretrain 有用。
recommendation.en: Skim the technical design: training-time registers distill geometric priors, then the branch is dropped at inference—a useful embodied-pretraining tradeoff.

paper.title: Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning: Self-Aware Policy Execution for VLA Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are powerful action generators for robot manipulation, but they are typically executed with fixed inference and replanning schedules. This rigidity ignores the uneven difficulty of robot control: contact-rich or uncertain states may need more computation and fresher feedback, while easier states can often be handled with fewer inference steps and longer open-loop execution. We propose Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning (EQRL), a framework that makes each V

summary.core_problem: VLA 机器人策略通常用固定推理频率、固定去噪步数和固定动作块长度执行，无法按状态难度分配计算量。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个面向具身策略执行的自适应 test-time compute 框架。它不改底层 VLA 模型，而是在执行层决定何时多算、何时少算，对预训练研究的价值主要在于多模态策略的动态计算分配思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning。轻量 latent-schedule adaptor 联合选择 latent input、denoising budget 和 action chunk length；用 critic ensemble 对 joint latent-schedule action 建模，并用 critic 分歧估计状态难度；难状态分配更多计算和更短开环执行，简单状态减少查询频率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体机器人任务数量、底层 VLA 参数量、训练数据规模、baseline 名称或提升幅度。可确认的是方法定位为不微调底层 VLA，只训练执行调度模块，并面向 contact-rich 或不确定状态的机器人 manipulation。

summary_en.core_problem: VLA policies are usually executed with fixed inference and replanning schedules, which wastes compute on easy states and under-computes hard contact-rich states.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an adaptive execution-time compute allocation framework for embodied VLA policies. Its relevance to pretraining research is indirect: it gives a concrete example of difficulty-aware compute scheduling for multimodal action models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Elastic Queries Reinforcement Learning. A lightweight latent-schedule adaptor jointly selects latent input, denoising budget, and action chunk length. A critic ensemble over the joint latent-schedule action estimates state difficulty via disagreement, and a residual component allows task-driven corrections.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, dataset scale, exact baselines, or quantitative gains. It states that the underlying VLA model is not fine-tuned and the learned scheduling module targets robot manipulation with variable chunk execution.

recommendation.zh: 作为 VLA 执行层的动态算力分配案例看即可；预训练侧别过度解读，只扫 adaptor 和 critic disagreement 设计。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an execution-time compute allocation case for VLA policies; skim the adaptor and critic-disagreement design, not the robotics claims.

paper.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
paper.abstract: This work presents RepWAM, a representation-centric world action model (WAM) built on representation visual-action tokenizers. Existing WAMs typically inherit reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers from pretrained video generation models. Although these tokenizers preserve visual fidelity, pixel reconstruction alone provides limited guidance for learning instruction-following dynamics that connect future prediction with robot control. To address this, we explore a semantic visual-action latent

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个能更好地将未来预测与机器人控制联系起来的、基于表示的世界动作模型（WAM）？
summary.importance: 指出现有基于重建的视频tokenizer在学习指令跟随动态（连接预测与控制）方面存在局限，提出了一种基于语义视觉-动作潜在空间的表示中心WAM。
summary.technical_approach: 训练一个表示视觉-动作tokenizer，将视觉输入映射到对齐的视觉和潜在动作token。然后预训练WAM，在语言指令下联合建模未来视觉状态和连接它们的潜在动作，最后适应真实机器人轨迹进行闭环操作。
summary.experiments: 在真实世界操作任务和模拟基准测试中进行了实验，表明RepWAM提供了更好的性能（具体提升幅度未在摘要中说明）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自复旦大学、蚂蚁集团等，Yu-Gang Jiang是复旦大学知名教授，Yujun Shen在生成模型领域有丰富经验。

summary_en.core_problem: How to build a representation-centric World Action Model (WAM) that better connects future prediction with robot control?
summary_en.importance: Identifies limitations of existing reconstruction-oriented video tokenizers in learning instruction-following dynamics (connecting prediction and control), and proposes a representation-centric WAM based on a semantic visual-action latent space.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a representation visual-action tokenizer mapping visual inputs to aligned visual and latent action tokens. Pretrains the WAM to jointly model future visual states and connecting latent actions under language instructions, followed by adaptation to real robot trajectories for closed-loop manipulation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on real-world manipulation tasks and simulation benchmarks show RepWAM delivers better performance (specific improvements not detailed in abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Fudan University, Ant Group, etc. Yu-Gang Jiang is a well-known professor at Fudan, and Yujun Shen has extensive experience in generative models.

recommendation.zh: 探索了视觉-动作联合 tokenizer 的设计，对多模态统一预训练中如何离散化和对齐控制信号有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Explores the design of a joint visual-action tokenizer, offering reference value for discretizing and aligning control signals in unified multimodal pretraining.

paper.title: DAM-VLA: Decoupled Asynchronous Multimodal Vision Language Action model
paper.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models inherit a shared synchronous clock from vision-language pretraining, processing every input at one rate. This is misaligned with physical interaction, where a high-frequency modality changes at hundreds of hertz, vision evolves more slowly, and language stays constant across an episode. A synchronous VLA oversamples slow modalities, undersamples fast ones, and caps action generation at the lowest effective frequency. We hypothesize that decoupling temporal pro

summary.core_problem: 现有VLA模型继承VL预训练的同步时钟假设，无法适配物理交互中不同模态更新速率差异，导致高频模态欠采样、性能受限
summary.importance: 提出解耦异步时序的多模态VLA架构，在不改动预训练主干的前提下支持异频模态接入
summary.technical_approach: 为每个模态维护独立的隐状态缓冲区，按各自传感器频率刷新，动作头持续读取缓冲区输出；新增高频模态通过门控交叉注意力接入，全程冻结预训练主干
summary.experiments: 在7个真实世界接触丰富的机器人操作任务上，平均成功率较同步VLA基线提升1倍以上

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLA models inherit the synchronous clock assumption from vision-language pretraining, which mismatches the varying update rates of different modalities in physical interaction, leading to undersampling of high-frequency modalities and limited performance.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a decoupled asynchronous multimodal VLA architecture that supports integration of modalities with different sampling rates without modifying the pretrained backbone.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maintains per-modality latent buffers refreshed at native sensor rates, continuously read by the action head; new high-frequency modalities are integrated via gated cross-attention while keeping the pretrained backbone fully frozen.
summary_en.experiments: Across 7 real-world contact-rich robot manipulation tasks, average success rate is more than double that of synchronous VLA baselines.

recommendation.zh: 异步多模态解耦思路有一定参考性，但设计针对机器人场景，无通用多模态预训练实验，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: The asynchronous multimodal decoupling idea is a useful reference, but the design is robotics-specific with no general multimodal pretraining experiments; read the abstract only.

paper.title: RhinoVLA Technical Report
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong potential for robotic manipulation, but real-time deployment on edge hardware remains challenging. In this work, we identify VLM visual and context tokens as a major source of deployment latency: for GEMM-dominated projection operators, computation grows linearly with the number of input tokens when model dimensions are fixed. Motivated by this observation, we propose RhinoVLA, a deployment-oriented VLA model co-designed with the Huixi R1 edg

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLA 模型在边缘硬件实时部署时，视觉与上下文 token 数过多导致投影算子和整体推理延迟过高的问题。
summary.importance: 这是部署导向的 VLA 技术报告，价值主要在多模态 token 效率与软硬件协同设计。对做统一多模态预训练的人有一些启发，但离 LLM 基座预训练主线仍有距离。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RhinoVLA：基于 token-efficient 的 Qwen3-VL 骨干和连续动作专家，减少 VLM 侧 token 与计算负担；同时设计统一机器人接口，把 View Registry、72 维物理状态-动作槽位和 robot-instance LoRA 结合起来，以支持异构机器人在共享策略下对齐观测与动作空间；部署上与 Huixi R1 边缘 SoC 协同优化。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调部署延迟来自输入 token 数线性增长，并声称在跨机器人学习和边缘部署上有效，但未给出模型参数量、训练数据规模、主要 baseline 和具体性能/时延数字。更像系统技术报告而非可复用的预训练 recipe。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Huixi Intelligence，属于机器人/VLA 工程团队；从题目和摘要看，重点是 edge deployment 与 VLA 软硬件协同，而不是通用多模态基座训练。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the real-time deployment bottleneck of VLA models on edge hardware, where too many visual and context tokens drive up projection cost and end-to-end latency.
summary_en.importance: This is a deployment-oriented VLA technical report. Its main value lies in multimodal token efficiency and hardware-software co-design. It offers some signal for unified multimodal pretraining, but it is still off the main path of LLM foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RhinoVLA uses a token-efficient Qwen3-VL backbone plus a continuous action expert to reduce VLM-side token and compute load. It also introduces a unified robot interface combining a View Registry, a 72D physical state-action slot space, and robot-instance LoRA to align heterogeneous robot observations and action schemas under a shared policy, co-designed with the Huixi R1 edge SoC.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract argues that latency scales linearly with input token count for GEMM-dominated projection operators and claims gains in cross-robot learning and edge deployment, but does not report model size, training scale, baselines, or concrete quality/latency numbers. It reads more like a systems technical report than a reusable pretraining recipe.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Huixi Intelligence, apparently a robotics/VLA engineering team. From the title and abstract, the emphasis is edge deployment and VLA hardware-software co-design rather than general multimodal foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 native multimodal，可只看它对 token 数与延迟线性关系的拆解；其余多是机器人接口工程，别误当成预训练论文。
recommendation.en: If you work on native multimodal models, only the token-count vs latency breakdown is worth skimming; the rest is mostly robotics interface engineering.

paper.title: Flash-WAM: Modality-Aware Distillation for World Action Models
paper.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) jointly generate future video and robot actions through iterative diffusion, achieving strong performance on manipulation benchmarks but requiring tens of denoising steps, a cost that precludes real-time control. Step distillation has emerged as the natural remedy, but off-the-shelf methods break down in the joint video-action setting because video and action streams use different SNR-shifted noise schedules and reach training with substantially different marginal nois

summary.core_problem: 联合生成“未来视频+机器人动作”的扩散式world-action model推理太慢（多步去噪），需要在不崩性能的前提下做少步/一步蒸馏。
summary.importance: 属于扩散模型推理加速/蒸馏的工程方法论文；对做AR+diffusion统一建模或多流噪声日程的人有一些可迁移的经验，但不是LLM预训练主线。
summary.technical_approach: 指出视频流与动作流存在不同噪声日程与边际噪声分布（SNR shift），单一蒸馏参数化会失配；提出modality-aware step distillation：动作流用线性梯度缩放参数化以适配低噪声区间，视频流用variance-preserving参数化以适配高噪声区间，并借鉴consistency distillation选择每个模态的consistency function。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集规模与量化指标细节；描述为在机器人操作(manipulation)基准上实现更少denoising steps下的性能保持与实时控制可行性提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion-based world-action models that jointly generate future video and robot actions are too slow for real-time control; they need aggressive step reduction without collapsing performance.
summary_en.importance: An inference-acceleration/distillation paper for diffusion models; potentially transferable to multi-stream (AR+diffusion) setups, but not central to LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argues video vs action streams have different noise schedules and marginal noise distributions (SNR shift), making single-modality distillation mismatched. Proposes modality-aware step distillation: linear gradient-scaling parameterization for the action stream (low-noise regime) and variance-preserving parameterization for the video stream (high-noise regime), inspired by consistency distillation with per-modality consistency functions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete model/data sizes or numeric results; claims improved performance retention under fewer denoising steps on manipulation benchmarks, enabling closer-to-real-time control.

recommendation.zh: 想做多流扩散（视频+动作/多模态token）蒸馏的可看：核心是“不同模态不同噪声参数化”，但更偏工程配方，先看方法段落即可。
recommendation.en: Worth a skim if you distill multi-stream diffusion models: the key is per-modality noise/parameterization mismatch, but it’s mostly a recipe—read the method and move on.

paper.title: Humanoid-GPT: Scaling Data and Structure for Zero-Shot Motion Tracking
paper.abstract: We introduce Humanoid-GPT, a GPT-style Transformer with causal attention trained on a billion-scale motion corpus for whole-body control. Unlike prior shallow MLP trackers constrained by scarce data and an agility-generalization trade-off, Humanoid-GPT is pre-trained on a 2B-frame retargeted corpus that unifies all major mocap datasets with large-scale in-house recordings. Scaling both data and model capacity yields a single generative Transformer that tracks highly dynamic behaviors while achie

summary.core_problem: 用大规模序列模型统一学习 humanoid 全身运动跟踪，解决传统小模型在动态动作和零样本泛化之间的取舍。
summary.importance: 贡献是把 GPT-style causal Transformer 和十亿级 motion corpus 用到机器人全身控制上。对 LLM 预训练研究的价值在于“运动 token/轨迹作为语言建模对象”的缩放经验，而不是文本 LLM recipe。
summary.technical_approach: Humanoid-GPT 使用 causal attention Transformer，对重定向后的大规模 motion 序列进行预训练。数据侧统一主流 mocap 数据集和内部采集数据；结构侧用更大容量的生成式 Transformer 替代传统浅层 MLP tracker。
summary.experiments: 使用约 2B frame 的 retargeted motion corpus，评估 unseen motions 和 unseen control tasks 的 zero-shot tracking。摘要称包含 scaling analyses，并在高动态复杂动作和泛化任务上建立更强性能边界，但未给出参数量、baseline 细节或具体提升数值。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Tsinghua University、Galbot Inc、Shanghai Jiao Tong University、Peking University、Shanghai Qi Zhi、Scalable Architecture。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper uses large sequence models for humanoid whole-body motion tracking, targeting the trade-off between agile behavior tracking and zero-shot generalization.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is importing GPT-style causal sequence modeling and billion-frame motion pretraining into robot control. For LLM pretraining researchers, the useful signal is the scaling behavior of motion-as-sequence modeling, not a text-LM training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: Humanoid-GPT is a causal-attention Transformer pretrained on retargeted motion sequences. The data pipeline unifies major mocap datasets with large in-house recordings, while the model replaces shallow MLP trackers with a higher-capacity generative Transformer.
summary_en.experiments: The model is trained on a roughly 2B-frame retargeted motion corpus and evaluated on zero-shot tracking of unseen motions and control tasks. The abstract mentions scaling analyses and stronger performance on dynamic behaviors, but does not provide parameter counts, detailed baselines, or exact gains.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include Tsinghua University, Galbot Inc, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Peking University, Shanghai Qi Zhi, and Scalable Architecture.

recommendation.zh: 读摘要和 scaling 图即可；有 motion-as-LM 的信号，但机器人控制指标难反推通用预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and scaling plots; it offers motion-as-LM signal, but robot-control metrics do not cleanly transfer to general pretraining.

paper.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation
paper.abstract: Real-world household robots require Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models that can acquire reusable manipulation skills across diverse objects, task conditions, and household environments. Deformable-object folding is a representative challenge, requiring robots to handle clothing items from random initial states across varying categories, geometries, materials, and scenes. However, existing VLA systems commonly train separate policies for different object categories, while naively mixe

summary.core_problem: 现有VLA系统通常为不同物体类别训练独立策略，混合多任务训练存在任务干扰和性能下降问题，难以实现可泛化的可变形物体操作
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出统一的视觉-语言-动作基础模型用于可变形物体操作，采用流匹配生成连续动作
summary.technical_approach: DeMaVLA采用VLM骨干网络加动作专家的结构，使用流匹配公式化连续动作生成；动作专家通过隔层裁剪Transformer层构建，同时保持与VLM骨干的层级对齐
summary.experiments: 论文未完成展示完整实验结果（摘要被截断），涉及衣物折叠等可变形物体操作任务

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLA systems train separate policies for different object categories, and naive mixed multi-task training suffers from task interference and performance degradation, limiting generalizable deformable object manipulation
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: a unified vision-language-action foundation model for deformable manipulation using flow matching for continuous action generation
summary_en.technical_approach: DeMaVLA uses a VLM backbone with an action expert, formulating continuous action generation via flow matching; the action expert is built by pruning every other Transformer layer while maintaining layer-wise alignment with the VLM backbone
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental results not fully shown in abstract (truncated); involves deformable object manipulation tasks such as clothing folding

recommendation.zh: 机器人操作领域的多模态VLA工作，对LLM预训练研究员的直接价值有限，仅作领域动态了解
recommendation.en: A multimodal VLA work in robotics manipulation, of limited direct value to LLM pretraining researchers — useful only as field dynamics awareness

paper.title: VLA-Pro: Cross-Task Procedural Memory Transfer for Vision-Language-Action Models
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) models have shown strong potential for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet they still struggle to generalize to unseen tasks that necessitate transferring relevant experience across objects, scenes, and action patterns. This paper proposes VLA-Pro, a plug-and-play framework designed to enhance cross-task generalization by storing task-relevant procedural memories at training time and transferring these memories during inference. Specifically, VLA-Pro stores tas

summary.core_problem: 提升 Vision-Language-Action 模型在未见机器人任务上的跨任务泛化，尤其是需要迁移对象、场景和动作模式经验的任务。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 VLA 推理时记忆迁移机制：把任务 LoRA 适配器当作程序性记忆检索和融合。对通用多模态预训练不是直接贡献，但与参数化记忆、adapter 路由和模块组合有关。
summary.technical_approach: VLA-Pro 在训练阶段为不同任务保存 task-specific LoRA adapters，作为参数化 procedural memories；推理时根据当前多模态上下文检索相关记忆，并动态融合这些 LoRA 参数来生成 action chunk。方法是 plug-and-play，可挂在多个 VLA backbone 上。
summary.experiments: 在 RoboTwin、RLBench 和真实机器人操作任务上评估；摘要称多个 backbone 均有提升，仿真中最高达到 207% 相对提升，真实场景成功率也提高，但未给出完整模型规模和绝对数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to improve cross-task generalization in Vision-Language-Action models for unseen robotic manipulation tasks requiring transfer of object, scene, and action experience.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time procedural-memory transfer mechanism for VLA models. It is not a direct pretraining result, but it is relevant to parametric memory, adapter routing, and modular composition.
summary_en.technical_approach: VLA-Pro stores task-specific LoRA adapters during training as parameterized procedural memories. At inference time, it retrieves memories using the current multimodal context and dynamically fuses the selected adapters to generate the action chunk.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on RoboTwin, RLBench, and real-world manipulation tasks. The abstract reports consistent gains across multiple backbones, with up to 207% relative improvement in simulation and improved real-world success rates, but full absolute metrics and model sizes are not provided.

recommendation.zh: 只看记忆检索和 LoRA 融合设计；机器人结果不必深读，但这个 adapter-as-memory 设定可借鉴到工具和多模态持续学习。
recommendation.en: Skim the retrieval and LoRA-fusion design; the robotics results are secondary, but adapter-as-memory is reusable for tool use and multimodal continual learning.

paper.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
paper.abstract: Embodied intelligence is often studied through specialized models for individual tasks such as manipulation or navigation, resulting in fragmented capabilities and limited generalization across tasks, environments, and robot embodiments. In this work, we study whether heterogeneous embodied decision-making problems can be unified within a single vision-language-action model. We present Qwen-VLA, a unified embodied foundation model that extends Qwen's vision-language modeling stack from perceptio

summary.core_problem: 具身智能模型通常针对单一任务（如机械臂操作或导航）设计，导致能力碎片化。如何在一个统一的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中，处理不同机器人形态、任务类型、动作维度和控制频率的异构决策问题？
summary.importance: 展示了如何将 LLM 的通用预训练范式扩展到具身控制领域，通过统一的动作表示和大规模混合数据预训练，实现跨任务和跨形态的泛化，是迈向通用具身基础模型的重要一步。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Qwen-VLA。基于 Qwen3.5-4B 视觉语言主干，接入基于 DiT（Diffusion Transformer）的动作解码器（Flow-Matching）。核心设计包括：1) 统一动作空间：将机械臂操作、导航路点、人类第一人称运动统一表示；2) 具身感知提示（Embodiment-aware prompt）：在输入前附加当前机器人的形态描述（平台、控制频率、预测步长等），作为模型理解特定控制语义的唯一接口；3) 大规模联合预训练：混合机器人轨迹、人类视频、导航数据、合成数据及 VLM 预训练数据。
summary.experiments: 通过大规模联合预训练，Qwen-VLA 能够吸收多种具身数据源的监督信号，在保持 VLM 原有感知和推理能力的同时，实现了对连续高维动作的精准预测，并展现出跨形态的泛化潜力。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对异构具身任务统一建模的思考，以及 Embodiment-aware prompt conditioning 的具体设计。这种通过 prompt 注入形态先验，结合 DiT 解码器处理连续动作的架构，是当前 VLA 模型的典型范式。

summary_en.core_problem: Embodied intelligence models are typically designed for single tasks (e.g., manipulation or navigation), leading to fragmented capabilities. How can heterogeneous decision-making problems across different robot embodiments, task types, action dimensions, and control frequencies be unified within a single Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model?
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates how to extend the general pre-training paradigm of LLMs to embodied control. By using a unified action representation and large-scale mixed-data pre-training, it achieves cross-task and cross-embodiment generalization, marking a significant step towards general-purpose embodied foundation models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Qwen-VLA. Built on the Qwen3.5-4B vision-language backbone, it attaches a DiT-based (Flow-Matching) action decoder. Core designs include: 1) Unified action space: represents manipulation, navigation waypoints, and human egocentric motions uniformly; 2) Embodiment-aware prompt conditioning: prepends a description of the current robot embodiment (platform, control frequency, prediction horizon, etc.) to the input, serving as the sole interface for the model to understand specific control semantics; 3) Large-scale joint pre-training: mixes robot trajectories, human videos, navigation data, synthetic data, and VLM pre-training data.
summary_en.experiments: Through large-scale joint pre-training, Qwen-VLA absorbs supervision from diverse embodied data sources. It achieves precise prediction of continuous high-dimensional actions while preserving the original perception and reasoning capabilities of the VLM, demonstrating cross-embodiment generalization potential.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the discussion in the Introduction regarding the unified modeling of heterogeneous embodied tasks, and the specific design of Embodiment-aware prompt conditioning. This architecture—injecting embodiment priors via prompts and handling continuous actions with a DiT decoder—is a representative paradigm for current VLA models.

recommendation.zh: VLA 不只是机器人应用；先看数据混合和 DiT action decoder 怎样接到 Qwen-VL，任务指标可后看。
recommendation.en: This is more than a robotics demo; read the data mixture and DiT action-decoder interface to Qwen-VL before caring about task scores.

paper.title: GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence
paper.abstract: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance and generalization in robotics, particularly within Vision-Language-Action frameworks. However, a significant gap remains between the high-level semantic focus of standard text-guided pre-training paradigms and the low-level spatial and physical knowledge critical for execution in embodied environments. In this paper, we introduce GEM, a Generative-supervised Embodied vision-language Model designed to bridge this div

summary.core_problem: 解决具身 VLM 预训练偏重高层语义、缺少低层空间与物理知识，导致执行阶段感知-动作脱节的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个多模态预训练配方改进工作：把深度图生成作为联合监督信号引入具身 VLM 预训练，并配套构建 4M 规模数据集，目标是提升机器人场景中的空间理解与操作能力。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 GEM，在标准视觉-语言建模之外加入 depth map generation 生成式监督，让模型在预训练阶段同时学习语义对齐与几何结构。论文还发布 GEM-4M，混合 grounding、reasoning、planning 等数据，并配有高质量深度监督，用于支撑这一联合训练范式。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称在 embodied intelligence / Vision-Language-Action 场景上带来显著提升，尤其改善语义理解和物理操作能力；但从给定信息看，尚无法确认模型规模、训练 token/样本量、具体 baseline、提升幅度和是否在主流基准上形成稳定领先。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the mismatch between semantically oriented VLM pretraining and the low-level spatial/physical knowledge required for embodied execution.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal pretraining recipe change: it adds depth-map generation as an auxiliary generative objective and releases a 4M-scale dataset to improve spatial grounding and action-relevant understanding in embodied settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: GEM jointly trains a VLM with its main objective plus a depth generation task, so the model learns semantic alignment together with geometric structure. The accompanying GEM-4M dataset mixes grounding, reasoning, and planning data with depth supervision to support this setup.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial gains on embodied intelligence and VLA-style tasks, especially in semantic understanding and physical operation. However, from the provided information, model size, training scale, baselines, exact margins, and the cleanliness of the evaluation setup are still unclear.

recommendation.zh: 对纯文本 pretrain 启发有限，但若你在看 native multimodal 或机器人预训练，先查数据构成和 auxiliary loss 权重；很多这类收益最后都来自数据而不是目标本身。
recommendation.en: Limited value for text-only pretraining, but if you care about native multimodal/robotics pretraining, inspect the data mix and auxiliary-loss weighting first; gains in this line often come more from data than from the objective.

paper.title: AttenA+: Rectifying Action Inequality in Robotic Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Existing robotic foundation models, while powerful, are predicated on an implicit assumption of temporal homogeneity: treating all actions as equally informative during optimization. This "flat" training paradigm, inherited from language modeling, remains indifferent to the underlying physical hierarchy of manipulation. In reality, robot trajectories are fundamentally heterogeneous, where low-velocity segments often dictate task success through precision-demanding interactions, while high-veloci

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论机器人基础模型中的 action token 训练权重问题。现有 VLA 和 World-Action Model 通常对轨迹中每个动作步使用相同 loss 权重，但真实操作轨迹并不均匀：快速移动多是容错的过渡段，慢速接触、对齐、抓取和放置阶段更容易决定任务成败。
summary.importance: 这不是通用 LLM 预训练论文，但对跨模态统一建模有一个清晰启发：非文本 token 不一定适合沿用语言建模里的均匀 token loss。对 action、audio、video 这类带物理时间结构的序列，token 的训练权重可能应该由模态内的物理先验决定。AttenA+ 给了一个简单例子：用末端执行器速度作为无需标注的关键性 proxy，把优化预算更多放在精细操作片段上。
summary.technical_approach: AttenA+ 是一个不改模型结构的 loss reweighting 框架。它先从专家轨迹中计算每个 timestep 的动作速度，速度可以来自平移维度、旋转维度，或二者组合。核心假设是速度越低，动作越可能处在接触丰富、精度要求高的阶段，因此每步 loss 的权重应随速度降低而增大。这个权重可以乘到不同训练目标上：回归式 VLA 的 L1/L2 action loss，diffusion policy 的 score-matching loss，或 flow matching 模型的 vector-field loss。方法的优点是参数量不变，数据不需要额外人工标注，主要引入的是一个物理先验驱动的优化重排。
summary.experiments: 论文在 Libero 和 RoboTwin 上评估，并在 Franka 机械臂上做真实环境验证。报告的主要现象是：AttenA+ 能提高长程操作和精细接触阶段的成功率，标准均匀 loss baseline 更容易在最后几厘米的对齐、抓取或放置阶段失败。提供的正文片段没有包含完整表格和具体提升数字，因此数值结论需要在实验章节中核对，尤其是不同 backbone、不同任务长度、以及低速片段加权强度的消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15 到 20 分钟。先看 Figure 2 的速度分布和任务阶段对应关系，确认“低速等于高关键性”这个假设是否在数据上站得住。再看方法部分的权重函数、归一化和是否有 clipping，因为这些细节决定训练是否会过度偏向静止或近静止动作。实验部分重点看三个消融：均匀 loss 对比速度加权、不同 VLA/WAM backbone 的迁移性、真实机器人上精细操作阶段的失败案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies loss weighting for action sequences in robotic foundation models. Current VLA and world-action models often train with a flat per-timestep objective, treating all action tokens as equally important. Manipulation trajectories are not uniform: fast motions are often transitional and tolerant to error, while slow contact-rich phases such as alignment, grasping, and placement tend to determine task success.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core text-LLM pretraining paper, but it is relevant to unified multimodal pretraining. It makes a concrete point that non-text tokens may not deserve the uniform loss treatment inherited from language modeling. For action, audio, and video tokens with physical temporal structure, token importance can be shaped by modality-specific signals. AttenA+ uses end-effector velocity as an annotation-free proxy for action criticality and reallocates optimization pressure toward precision-sensitive segments.
summary_en.technical_approach: AttenA+ is a plug-in loss reweighting method. It computes the instantaneous velocity of the ground-truth action at each timestep, using translational dimensions, rotational dimensions, or both. The training loss at each step is then multiplied by a velocity-derived weight, with lower-velocity actions receiving higher emphasis. The same idea can be applied to regression-based VLA objectives, diffusion-policy score-matching losses, and flow-matching vector-field losses. The method does not require architectural changes or extra parameters; it changes the optimization objective by injecting a simple kinematic prior.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers Libero and RoboTwin, with additional real-world experiments on a Franka manipulator. The reported pattern is that velocity-weighted training improves success in long-horizon manipulation and especially in precision-critical phases, where uniformly weighted baselines often fail near final alignment, grasp, or placement. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so exact gains, backbone-specific behavior, and weighting-strength ablations should be checked in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 15- to 20-minute skim is sufficient. Start with the velocity analysis around Figure 2 to judge whether low velocity reliably corresponds to high manipulation criticality. Then inspect the weighting formula, normalization, and any clipping or smoothing details, since these determine whether the method overweights stationary actions. In the experiments, focus on uniform-loss comparisons, transfer across different robotic backbones, and real-robot failure cases in the last-centimeter phase.

recommendation.zh: 读 loss weighting 和 ablation；它把“语言式均匀 token loss”在动作模态上的失配讲清楚，值得做内部 sanity check。
recommendation.en: Read the loss weighting and ablations; it cleanly exposes where language-style uniform token loss mismatches action modalities and deserves an internal sanity check.

paper.title: Reinforcing VLAs in Task-Agnostic World Models
paper.abstract: Post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models via reinforcement learning (RL) in learned world models has emerged as an effective strategy to adapt to new tasks without costly real-world interactions. However, while using imagined trajectories reduces the sample complexity of policy training, existing methods still heavily rely on task-specific data to fine-tune both the world and reward models, fundamentally limiting their scalability to unseen tasks. To overcome this, we argue that world a

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是一般意义上的机器人策略优化，而是一个更具体、也更卡脖子的问题：如何在目标任务完全未参与世界模型训练的前提下，用冻结的 world model 和冻结的 reward source，对新任务做高数据效率的 VLA 后训练。现有基于 imagined rollout 的 VLA-RL 方法虽然减少了真实交互，但 world model 往往仍要用目标任务数据重训或微调，reward 也常依赖任务专用分类器、参考轨迹或人工设计信号，所以一旦任务变了，整套流程都要重新收集数据。RAW-Dream 把这个依赖拆开：world model 只学任务无关的物理动态，reward 由通用 VLM 对 imagined video + instruction 做零样本判定，目标任务只需要少量 demonstration 把 policy 对齐到任务语义，再在梦境里做 RL。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义不在于它提出了一个新的 backbone，而在于它把“可复用的 task-agnostic simulator”明确成了一个预训练对象，并给出了一条比 task-specific world-model RL 更干净的扩展路线。这里有三个层面的价值。第一，它把 world model 的训练目标从“服务某个任务”改成“覆盖 embodiment 的物理先验”，这和基座模型预训练里追求 transferable prior 的思路是一致的。第二，它把 reward 从任务内监督中解耦出来，改用冻结 VLM 做 zero-shot success judgment，这相当于把通用视觉语义能力接到了 RL 后训练接口上。第三，它说明在 VLA 场景里，预训练和后训练的边界可以重新划分：world model 与 reward 准备一次，后续只适配 policy。这个范式如果成立，影响的是数据预算结构，而不只是单点指标提升。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三块。第一块是 task-agnostic action-conditioned video world model。作者基于 WAN 2.1 搭建动作条件视频生成器，但训练数据严格来自 broad-coverage、与下游任务无关的交互数据，例如 play data 或 benchmark 中不含目标任务的任务集合。关键点不是模型结构新，而是训练约束新：world model 不允许看 target-task rollout，因此它必须靠更广覆盖的行为分布去学可迁移的物理动力学，而不是记住任务模板。

第二块是 zero-shot reward。作者不训练任务专用 reward model，而是把 imagined rollout 视频和文本指令交给冻结的 Qwen3-VL，由其直接判断任务是否成功，输出二值奖励。这样 reward source 也不再依赖目标任务标注器。这里的取舍很清楚：牺牲一部分 reward 精细度，换取跨任务可复用性和零额外标注。

第三块是在 world model 内做 policy optimization。策略采用 OpenVLA-OFT，先用极少量 demonstration 做 SFT，把策略锚定到新任务语义；然后在冻结 world model 中用 GRPO 做 RL。由于 imagined rollout 在未见任务上更容易出现 hallucinated success，作者加了 dual-noise verification：对同一初始条件，用不同 diffusion noise 生成多条 rollout，只有当 VLM reward 在不同噪声下保持一致时，才把该奖励视为可信。这一步不是简单 ensemble，而是专门针对生成式 world model 的 reward hacking 问题：如果成功只在某个噪声样本里出现，往往说明是模型幻觉而非稳定可实现的轨迹。

从方法定位看，RAW-Dream 的创新不在单个组件，而在组合方式和约束设计。它没有重新发明 VLA、VLM 或 video diffusion WM，而是把三者放进一个严格 task-agnostic 的后训练闭环里，并补上了 hallucination-aware reward verification 这个必要环节。
summary.experiments:
实验分成仿真和真实机器人两部分。仿真上，作者在 LIBERO 上训练 world model 时只使用 LIBERO-90 数据，并把 Spatial、Object、Goal、Long 四个 held-out task suites 作为 world-model 训练时完全未见的下游任务。这个设定比常见的 imagined RL 更严格，因为不是同任务低样本，而是 world model 对目标任务零暴露。结果上，RAW-Dream 相比 1-shot SFT baseline 带来 +8.9% 的提升，并且优于需要 50× 更多真实世界数据的 online RL。这个对比很关键，它说明 task-agnostic WM + zero-shot reward 并不是只在“省数据但性能差一些”的角落里成立，而是在数据效率上有明显优势。

真实机器人上，world model 只用多样、未清洗的 play data 预训练，不看目标任务数据。每个新任务从 3-shot SFT 起步，再进入 imagined RL。最终成功率相对 3-shot SFT baseline 有 +21.7% 的绝对提升。对机器人场景来说，这个幅度已经足以说明 dream-based RL 不是纯粹的模拟器内自娱自乐，而是能把少量 demonstration 放大成可观的真实收益。

从文中叙述看，值得注意的消融主要有三类：一是验证 task-agnostic WM 相比 target-task-specific 方案在 unseen-task setting 下的适配能力；二是验证 VLM zero-shot reward 的可用性；三是 dual-noise verification 对抑制 hallucinated success 和 false-positive reward hacking 的作用。虽然给出的摘要片段没有完整表格数字，但论文主结论依赖的不是单一主表，而是这三类消融共同支撑：world model 要足够通用，reward 要足够稳，RL 才能在未见任务上真正工作。
summary.reading_guide:
精读时先抓三处。第一是 Introduction 里对问题设定的限定：不是一般的 world-model RL，而是“target-task-agnostic VLA-RL optimization in WMs”。这句话决定了整篇工作的评价标准。第二是 Method 里 world model、zero-shot VLM reward、GRPO、dual-noise verification 之间的接口设计，尤其要看 reward 是如何从 imagined video 中提取、如何做一致性过滤，以及 policy 更新时哪些模块冻结、哪些模块可训练。第三是实验部分关于 LIBERO held-out suites 和 real-robot play-data 预训练的设定，这些设定决定了结果是否真的说明了 transferable physical prior，而不是数据泄漏。

如果时间有限，优先看：任务设定图、整体 pipeline 图、LIBERO 主结果表、dual-noise verification 消融、真实机器人结果。若要深挖，建议重点想两个问题：一，task-agnostic world model 的能力边界到底由数据覆盖决定，还是由生成模型 fidelity 决定；二，VLM reward 在 imagined video 上的误判会不会形成系统性偏差，dual-noise 只是降噪还是已经足够构成可靠的 reward filter。阅读时间大约 45–70 分钟，若连附录中的实现细节和失败案例一起看，可能需要更久。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific bottleneck in world-model-based VLA post-training: how to improve a policy on new tasks when the world model has never seen target-task rollouts and the reward source is also task-agnostic. Prior imagined-RL pipelines reduce real-world interaction cost, but they still depend on target-task data to train or adapt the world model, and often require task-specific reward classifiers or reference trajectories. That makes them hard to scale to unseen tasks. RAW-Dream reframes the setup: pretrain a reusable action-conditioned world model on broad interaction data, use a frozen VLM as a zero-shot reward judge over imagined videos plus instructions, and adapt only the policy with a small amount of demonstrations followed by RL inside the frozen simulator.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is not a new backbone but a cleaner decomposition of what should be pretrained once versus adapted per task. The world model is treated as a reusable physical prior rather than a task-bound simulator, and the reward is outsourced to a general VLM instead of a task-specific learned head. For pretraining-oriented readers, this matters because it shifts the scaling question from 'how much target-task data do I need to build a simulator' to 'how broad and transferable can my embodiment-level physical prior become.' It also gives a concrete pretrain-to-posttrain interface: prepare a task-agnostic simulator and reward mechanism once, then spend downstream data only on policy anchoring. That is a meaningful change in data allocation, not just a small algorithmic tweak.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three core pieces. First, a task-agnostic action-conditioned video world model. The implementation is built on WAN 2.1, but the important design choice is the training constraint: the world model is trained only on broad, target-task-independent interaction data such as play data or non-overlapping benchmark tasks. The goal is to learn transferable physical dynamics rather than task templates.

Second, zero-shot reward from a frozen VLM. Instead of training a reward model for each task, the method feeds imagined rollout videos and the language instruction into Qwen3-VL and asks for binary success judgments. This removes the need for task-specific reward supervision. The trade-off is clear: less reward shaping and less task specialization, in exchange for much better reuse across tasks.

Third, policy optimization inside the frozen world model. The policy backbone is OpenVLA-OFT. It is first lightly supervised with a few demonstrations to bind the policy to the new task semantics, then optimized with GRPO entirely in imagination. Because unseen-task rollouts from a generative world model can produce hallucinated successes, the paper adds a dual-noise verification mechanism: generate rollouts under different diffusion noise seeds from the same initial condition, and accept the reward only when the VLM judgment is consistent across them. This is a targeted defense against reward hacking induced by world-model hallucination. A success that appears only under one noise realization is treated as unreliable.

The novelty is therefore mostly in the system design and the constraints, not in inventing a new VLA, VLM, or video diffusion model. RAW-Dream turns existing components into a strictly task-agnostic post-training loop and adds the minimum extra machinery needed to make that loop stable on unseen tasks.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers both simulation and real robots. In simulation, the world model is trained only on LIBERO-90 data, while four held-out suites—Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long—are used as downstream tasks that are completely unseen during world-model training. This is a stronger test than the usual low-data adaptation setting because the simulator has zero exposure to the target tasks. RAW-Dream improves over a 1-shot SFT baseline by +8.9% and outperforms online RL despite the latter using 50x more real-world data. That comparison is important: the method is not merely data-efficient at the cost of weak performance; it is competitive in a regime where real interaction is expensive.

On real robots, the world model is pretrained only on diverse, uncurated play data, again without target-task rollouts. Each new task starts from a 3-shot SFT policy and is then refined through imagined RL. The reported gain is +21.7% absolute success rate over the 3-shot SFT baseline. For robotic manipulation, that is a large enough margin to show that the imagined training signal is doing real work rather than producing simulator-only improvements.

The most important ablations appear to be: whether a task-agnostic world model can support unseen-task adaptation at all, whether zero-shot VLM reward is reliable enough to drive RL, and whether dual-noise verification reduces hallucinated success and false-positive reward hacking. Even without every table reproduced here, the paper’s empirical case depends on this combination rather than on a single headline number.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the problem definition in the introduction. The phrase to keep in mind is 'target-task-agnostic VLA-RL optimization in world models.' That is the real claim. Then read the method section with attention to the interfaces: how the imagined video is produced, how Qwen3-VL is prompted to score success, what is frozen versus trainable, and how GRPO consumes the filtered rewards. The dual-noise verification mechanism deserves close reading because it addresses a failure mode that is easy to miss if one only looks at average success rates.

In the experiments, focus on the exact train-test split for LIBERO and the real-robot setup using only play data for world-model pretraining. Those details determine whether the results truly demonstrate transferable physical priors or just hidden task overlap. If time is limited, read the pipeline figure, the main LIBERO table, the ablation on reward verification, and the real-robot results. If reading deeply, ask two questions: is the main bottleneck coverage of interaction data or fidelity of the generative world model, and is VLM-based reward merely noisy or systematically biased on imagined videos. Expect roughly 45–70 minutes for a careful pass, longer if you also inspect appendices and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和实验表；若结果扎实，它会改变 VLA 后训练里“每任务重训 world/reward”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure and main tables; if the results hold, it weakens the default of retraining world and reward models per VLA task.

paper.title: CSR: Infinite-Horizon Real-Time Policies with Massive Cached State Representations
paper.abstract: Deploying massive large language models (LLMs) as continuous cognitive engines for robotics is bottlenecked by the time-to-first-token (TTFT) latency required to process extensive state histories. Existing solutions like RAG or sliding windows compromise global context or incur prohibitive re-computation costs. We formalize the optimal task structure for minimizing latency and theoretically prove that prefix stability, incremental extensibility, and asynchronous state reconciliation are necessar

summary.core_problem: 大型 LLM 作为机器人连续认知引擎时，处理大量状态历史的 TTFT（time-to-first-token）延迟成为瓶颈。标准 KV-cache 只适合追加式序列，而机器人状态需要动态更新和旧数据驱逐，会导致缓存失效和全量重计算。
summary.importance: 对 LLM serving 系统设计有实际参考价值，特别是 KV-cache 复用策略和异步状态更新机制。理论上刻画的「前缀稳定性」和「增量可扩展性」两个必要条件，对长上下文连续推理系统设计有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 理论上证明了两个必要条件：前缀稳定性（历史上下文不可变以保持缓存有效）和增量可扩展性（新信息只能追加）。提出 Cached State Representation (CSR) 框架实现这些条件以最大化 KV-cache 复用。Asynchronous State Reconciliation (ASR) 算法将状态驱逐与主推理循环解耦，利用并行硬件预计算新状态的 KV-cache，消除延迟尖峰。
summary.experiments: 235B 参数模型在 120K token 上下文上实现 26 倍延迟降低（14.67s → 0.56s）。在 30B-235B 不同模型规模验证，实现 ≥2Hz 的高频响应。真实世界部署中无延迟尖峰，embodied AI 任务召回率 0.836（对比 RAG 的 0.459）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 Section 1（Introduction）和 Section 3（Cached State Representation）了解核心设计思路。实验部分看关键数字即可。对预训练研究者的参考价值在于理解长上下文 KV-cache 的工程约束，这可能影响未来长上下文模型的架构设计决策。预计阅读时间 15-20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: When large LLMs serve as continuous cognitive engines for robotics, TTFT (time-to-first-token) latency for processing extensive state histories becomes a bottleneck. Standard KV caching only works well for append-only sequences, but robotic state requires dynamic updates and obsolete data eviction, which invalidate the cache and force full recomputation.
summary_en.importance: Practical reference for LLM serving system design, especially KV-cache reuse strategies and asynchronous state update mechanisms. The theoretically characterized necessary conditions (prefix stability and incremental extensibility) inform long-context continuous reasoning system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Theoretically proves two necessary conditions: prefix stability (historical context must be immutable to preserve cache validity) and incremental extensibility (new information must be strictly appended). The Cached State Representation (CSR) framework implements these conditions for optimal KV-cache reuse. The Asynchronous State Reconciliation (ASR) algorithm decouples state eviction from the primary inference loop, using parallel hardware to precompute KV-cache for new states and eliminating latency spikes.
summary_en.experiments: 235B parameter model achieves 26× latency reduction (14.67s → 0.56s) on 120K token contexts. Validated across 30B–235B model sizes, achieving ≥2Hz high-frequency responsiveness. Bounded, spike-free operation in real-world deployments; embodied AI task recall 0.836 (vs. 0.459 for RAG).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 1 (Introduction) and Section 3 (Cached State Representation) for core design ideas. Just check the key numbers in experiments. For pretraining researchers, the reference value lies in understanding engineering constraints of long-context KV caching, which may inform future architectural design decisions for long-context models. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 关注长上下文推理和 KV-cache 管理的系统工作，其关于前缀稳定性和异步状态管理的理论分析对优化 LLM Serving 延迟有启发，可扫读方法部分。
recommendation.en: A systems paper focusing on long-context inference and KV-cache management; its theoretical analysis on prefix stability and asynchronous state management offers insights for optimizing LLM serving latency. Skim the methods section.

institutions: Graduate School of Informatics, Nagoya University, Aichi

paper.title: ForgeVLA: Federated Vision-Language-Action Learning without Language Annotations
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models hold great promise for general-purpose robotic intelligence, yet scaling up such models is severely bottlenecked by the high cost of acquiring annotated training data. Fortunately, vision-equipped robots deployed across various domains already produce abundant vision-action pairs that can be leveraged to scale up VLA training more efficiently. However, these raw data cannot be centrally aggregated due to various constraints and also exhibit severe heterogeneit

summary.core_problem: 解决机器人 VLA 训练中，分布式 vision-action 数据无法集中、且缺少语言标注导致难以扩展的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献点在联邦式 VLA 训练框架和无语言标注下的 triplet 构造，和多模态统一预训练有边缘相关性，但更偏机器人数据管线而非基座建模。
summary.technical_approach: ForgeVLA 在每个客户端部署 embodied instruction classifier，把 vision-action 对映射到预定义指令集合，补出语言模态形成 V-L-A triplet；随后在联邦学习设定下处理跨客户端异构性，联合训练 VLA 模型而不汇聚原始数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模。实验应围绕分布式机器人数据、无标注语言恢复质量、联邦训练稳定性和下游操控性能展开。对预训练研究员更值得看的部分是：缺失模态如何被离散 instruction set 近似恢复，以及这种弱语言监督是否足够支撑统一建模。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自四川大学、浙江大学。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles scalable VLA training when robot-generated vision-action data are distributed, heterogeneous, and lack language annotations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a federated VLA framework with pseudo-language recovery. It is only tangentially relevant to multimodal pretraining, leaning more toward robotics data pipelines than foundation-model modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: ForgeVLA equips each client with an embodied instruction classifier that maps vision-action pairs into a predefined instruction set, creating pseudo vision-language-action triplets. It then performs federated training while handling client heterogeneity without centralizing raw data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model size. The evaluation likely studies distributed robot datasets, pseudo-language recovery quality, federated robustness, and downstream control performance. For pretraining researchers, the interesting angle is whether weak recovered language is sufficient for unified modeling.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Sichuan University and Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 和预训练的交集只在“缺失语言模态如何补齐”这个点；若你关心 VLA 数据构造，可只看 pseudo-instruction 设计与异构客户端处理。
recommendation.en: The only real pretraining-adjacent idea is how missing language is reconstructed; if you care about VLA data formation, read the pseudo-instruction design and heterogeneity handling, nothing more.

paper.title: Characterizing Vision-Language-Action Models across XPUs: Constraints and Acceleration for On-Robot Deployment
paper.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are promising for generalist robot control, but on-robot deployment is bottlenecked by real-time inference under tight cost and energy budgets. Most prior evaluations rely on desktop-grade GPUs, obscuring the trade-offs and opportunities offered by heterogeneous edge accelerators (GPUs/XPUs/NPUs). We present a systematic analysis for low-cost VLA deployment via model-hardware co-characterization. First, we build a cross-accelerator leaderboard and evaluate mod

summary.core_problem: 研究 Vision-Language-Action 模型在机器人端侧部署时，如何在成本、能耗和控制时延约束下选择硬件并做推理加速。
summary.importance: 这是 VLA 部署效率分析和系统优化工作。它不直接改进预训练，但对多模态模型从云端 benchmark 走向机器人实时控制时的瓶颈拆解有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构建跨 GPU/XPU/NPU 的模型-硬件评测，使用 CET，即 Cost、Energy、Time，刻画部署权衡。通过 profiling 发现 VLA 推理存在两个阶段：计算受限的 VLM backbone 和内存受限的 Action Expert。基于该观察提出 DP-Cache 和 V-AEFusion，用于减少 diffusion/action 相关推理开销和阶段间低利用率。
summary.experiments: 实验包括跨加速器 leaderboard、模型-硬件配对的 CET 对比，以及对 VLM backbone 和 Action Expert 的细粒度 profiling。摘要称合适尺寸的边缘设备在满足控制频率时可比旗舰 GPU 更具成本和能耗效率，但未给出具体数值提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Shanghai Jiao Tong University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to deploy Vision-Language-Action models on robots under strict cost, energy, and real-time control constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is an efficiency and systems analysis paper for VLA deployment. It does not directly change pretraining, but it gives useful evidence about where multimodal action models spend compute and memory at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a cross-accelerator evaluation across GPUs, XPUs, and NPUs using CET: Cost, Energy, and Time. Profiling reveals a two-phase inference pattern: a compute-bound VLM backbone followed by a memory-bound Action Expert. The proposed DP-Cache and V-AEFusion target the diffusion/action-stage overhead and phase-dependent underutilization.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include a cross-accelerator leaderboard, CET comparisons for model-hardware pairs, and detailed profiling of the VLM backbone and Action Expert. The abstract claims that right-sized edge devices can be more cost- and energy-efficient than flagship GPUs while meeting control-rate constraints, but does not provide exact numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 profiling 图和 CET 表；对预训练无直接动作，但能校准 VLA 架构的推理瓶颈。
recommendation.en: Skim the profiling figures and CET tables; no direct pretraining action, but useful for calibrating VLA inference bottlenecks.

paper.title: LARY: A Latent Action Representation Yielding Benchmark for Generalizable Vision-to-Action Alignment

summary.core_problem: 如何“定量、可复现、可跨任务/跨主体”地评估从无标注人类视频中学习到的 latent action（潜在动作）表示质量，而不是把表示好坏混在下游机器人策略成败里一起评估。
summary.importance: VLA/机器人基础模型受限于显式动作标注数据稀缺；人类动作视频规模大但无动作本体（ontology）与控制信号。latent action 被视为连接“视觉变化”与“可控动作单元”的关键中间层，但此前缺少能同时覆盖语义层（what to do）与控制层（how to do）的统一基准，导致研究难以比较不同表示/训练范式的真实优劣与泛化能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LARYBench：将 latent action 表示的评估解耦为两条互补维度并落地为标准任务。(1) 高层语义动作：检验表示能否区分原子动作（如 move up/close gripper）与复合动作（如 pick/place/twist），对应任务为 Semantic Action Classification；(2) 低层控制映射：检验表示是否保留足够物理细节以重建末端执行器轨迹，对应任务为 Low-level Control Regression。为支撑评估，作者构建自动化数据引擎，对多源 embodied 视频进行再分割与再标注，形成覆盖人/机器人、第一/第三视角、仿真/真实的统一大规模基准（1.2M 短视频、620K 图像对、595K 轨迹、151 类动作、11 种机器人形态）。此外，系统性比较三类模型：Embodied LAM（面向操控的 latent action 模型）、General Vision Encoders（通用视觉表征，含语义级与像素级）、以及作者提出的 General LAM（在冻结通用视觉 backbone 上“嫁接”LAM 训练范式，如 LAPA-DINOv3/LAPA-SigLIP2 等），以隔离“视觉先验 vs latent action 训练”对表示质量的影响。
summary.experiments: 在 11 个模型上进行统一评测，得到稳定排序：通用视觉编码器 > 通用 LAM > 具身 LAM。结论包括：(i) 大规模视觉预训练即使无显式动作监督，也能涌现动作相关特征；(ii) 相比像素级特征空间，latent-based 特征空间在与机器人控制对齐上更有优势（更利于保留可用于控制的变化因素）。整体结果暗示：当前“具身专用”的 latent action 训练/架构可能未能充分利用强视觉先验，甚至可能对表示形成约束，从而降低泛化评估指标。
summary.reading_guide:
【skim 泛读】优先看：Introduction（为什么要“解耦评估”与两维度 what/how）、Benchmark Overview/Task Definition（两项任务如何从表示直接读出能力）、Experiments（11 模型对比的主结论与层级排序）、Conclusion（对未来 VLA 训练范式的启示）。
【must_read 精读】重点精读：1) 数据引擎与数据构成细节（再分割/再标注如何减少时序边界噪声与本体不一致；151 类动作与多视角/多主体覆盖如何实现可泛化评估）；2) 两个评测任务的形式化定义（输入是何种 latent action/特征，输出标签/轨迹如何对齐，评价指标如何避免“策略因素”混入）；3) 三类模型设定与对照（Embodied LAM vs General Vision Encoder vs General LAM 的训练冻结策略、tokenization/latent 单元的差异）；4) 关键对比图表：模型家族总体排名、语义分类与控制回归的分项结果、语义级 vs 像素级 backbone 的差异与误差分析（用于定位“表示缺失语义/缺失动力学”的具体症状）。
【创新点抓手】(a) 首次把 latent action 表示评估从下游策略中剥离并标准化；(b) 同时覆盖语义与控制两粒度；(c) 用“冻结通用视觉 backbone + LAM 训练”构造 General LAM 作为关键消融轴，直接检验‘latent action 训练范式’本身的增益/副作用。
summary.authors_note: 作者核心立场是：latent action 的研究需要像 NLP 的 token/embedding 一样先有“表示层面的基准”，否则下游操控成功与否无法归因。论文用大规模、跨主体/跨场景的数据与两维任务，把“表示是否真的编码了动作语义与可控动力学”变成可量化问题，并用系统对照指出：强视觉先验的重要性可能被低估，而具身专用 LAM 的训练方式可能需要重新设计以避免限制表示能力。

summary_en.core_problem: How to rigorously and quantitatively evaluate latent action representations learned from unlabeled human videos—separating representation quality from downstream robot policy performance—while testing generalization across agents, scenarios, and action granularities.
summary_en.importance: VLA and robotic foundation models are bottlenecked by scarce action-labeled data. Human action videos scale but lack consistent action ontologies and control signals. Latent actions are meant to bridge visual change and controllable action units, yet prior work mostly evaluates them indirectly via downstream manipulation success or qualitative clustering, making it hard to compare methods or understand what training choices actually improve generalizable action alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduce LARYBench, a unified benchmark that decouples latent-action evaluation into two complementary dimensions and instantiates them as standardized tasks: (1) High-level semantic intent (“what to do”) via Semantic Action Classification over atomic and composite actions; (2) Low-level physical controllability (“how to do it”) via Low-level Control Regression that tests whether representations preserve enough dynamics to reconstruct end-effector trajectories. To enable this, the authors build an automated data engine to re-segment and re-annotate heterogeneous embodied video sources, producing a large, unified corpus (1.2M short videos, 620K image pairs, 595K trajectories; 151 action categories; 11 robot embodiments; human/robot agents; egocentric/exocentric; sim/real). They benchmark three model families: Embodied LAMs, off-the-shelf General Vision Encoders (semantic-level and pixel-level), and proposed General LAMs created by grafting LAM training onto frozen general vision backbones (e.g., LAPA-DINOv3, LAPA-SigLIP2), isolating the effect of visual priors vs latent-action training paradigms.
summary_en.experiments: Across 11 models, results show a consistent hierarchy: General Vision Encoders outperform General LAMs, which outperform Embodied LAMs. Key findings: (i) action-relevant features can emerge from large-scale visual pretraining without explicit action supervision; (ii) latent-based feature spaces tend to align better with robotic control than pixel-based ones. The evidence suggests current embodied-specific latent-action training may underutilize strong visual priors and can even constrain representation quality under LARYBench metrics.
summary_en.reading_guide:
[Skim] Read: Introduction (motivation: evaluation decoupling + what/how split), Benchmark/Task definitions (what exactly is measured), Experiments (11-model comparison and the main ranking), Conclusion (implications for future VLA training).
[Must-read] Focus on: (1) the automated data engine and dataset composition (how re-segmentation/re-annotation addresses noisy temporal boundaries and inconsistent labels; how coverage enables generalization claims); (2) formal task setups and metrics (how inputs/outputs are aligned so evaluation targets representation rather than policy); (3) model-family design and controls (Embodied LAM vs General Encoder vs General LAM; freezing strategy; tokenization/latent units); (4) the main result tables/figures contrasting semantic classification vs control regression and semantic-level vs pixel-level backbones, plus any error analysis that diagnoses missing semantics vs missing dynamics.
[Innovation hooks] (a) first standardized, representation-level benchmark for latent actions decoupled from policy; (b) joint evaluation of semantic and control granularity; (c) “frozen backbone + LAM training” as a critical ablation axis to test whether the latent-action paradigm itself helps or hurts.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that latent actions need representation-centric benchmarks (akin to token/embedding evaluation in NLP) to make progress. By building a large, diverse benchmark and separating semantic understanding from control fidelity, the authors turn latent-action quality into a measurable target and argue—via systematic comparisons—that strong general visual priors matter more than commonly assumed, and that embodied-specific LAM training may require rethinking to avoid limiting representational capacity.

recommendation.zh: 基准比方法更有用：它把 latent action 表示从下游策略成败里解耦，建议直接看任务划分与指标定义，方便你评估自家表征是否真泛化。
recommendation.en: The benchmark matters more than the method—it decouples latent-action representation quality from downstream policy success; focus on task splits and metrics to test real generalization.

paper.title: StarVLA-$α$: Reducing Complexity in Vision-Language-Action Systems

summary.core_problem: VLA(视觉-语言-动作)机器人系统设计高度碎片化，如何用低复杂度强基线在统一设置下厘清关键设计因素并获得有竞争力的性能。
summary.importance: 范式/系统化贡献：提供“简单但强”的VLA基线以减少工程与架构混杂因素，便于研究者在统一多基准训练下做可控消融；对多模态对齐到动作空间的研究有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出StarVLA-α：刻意降低架构与训练管线复杂度，围绕动作建模策略、机器人特定预训练、接口工程等关键轴重新评估；强调强VLM backbone + 最小化设计即可达到强表现。
summary.experiments: 在LIBERO、SimplerEnv、RoboTwin、RoboCasa上进行统一多benchmark训练与对比；结论是该简单基线仍保持高度竞争力（摘要未给出参数规模、数据规模与具体提升数值）。

summary_en.core_problem: Vision-language-action (VLA) robotics systems are highly fragmented, making it hard to identify which design choices matter and to build a low-complexity yet competitive baseline under a unified training/evaluation setting.
summary_en.importance: By emphasizing a deliberately simple but strong VLA baseline, the work reduces confounding engineering complexity and enables more controlled ablations across multiple benchmarks, clarifying practical design factors for mapping multimodal inputs to actions.
summary_en.technical_approach: StarVLA-α intentionally simplifies architecture and training pipelines, re-examining key axes such as action modeling strategy, robot-specific pretraining, and interface/engineering choices, and argues that a strong VLM backbone plus minimal additional design can achieve strong performance.
summary_en.experiments: The system is trained and compared under a unified multi-benchmark setup on LIBERO, SimplerEnv, RoboTwin, and RoboCasa, showing competitive performance despite reduced complexity; the summary does not include parameter counts, data scale, or detailed metrics.

paper.title: TouchAnything: Diffusion-Guided 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Robot Touches

summary.core_problem: 仅依赖稀疏机器人触觉接触点时，如何在强欠约束条件下重建物体全局3D几何。
summary.importance: 方法上有一定启发：把大规模预训练2D视觉扩散模型作为跨模态几何先验迁移到触觉域，体现“生成式先验+跨模态约束”的范式；但整体仍偏机器人3D重建应用，对LLM基座研究相关性中等。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TouchAnything：利用预训练2D视觉扩散模型中隐含的语义/几何先验，通过将稀疏触觉接触约束（contact constraints）与粗粒度类别描述结合，进行扩散引导的3D重建；避免训练类别特定网络或从触觉数据直接学习扩散模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出所用视觉扩散模型类型/规模、触觉数据规模、重建指标（如Chamfer/IoU）及与触觉重建/生成先验基线的提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Reconstructing complete 3D object geometry from sparse robot touch contacts, an extremely underconstrained setting when only limited tactile points are available.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates a cross-modal paradigm that transfers priors from large pretrained 2D diffusion models to tactile-based 3D reconstruction, illustrating how generative priors can compensate for sparse physical measurements without training category-specific tactile models.
summary_en.technical_approach: Presents TouchAnything, which leverages semantic/geometric priors embedded in a pretrained 2D visual diffusion model and combines them with tactile contact constraints and coarse category descriptions to guide 3D reconstruction, avoiding learning a diffusion model directly from tactile data.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the diffusion backbone, tactile dataset scale, reconstruction metrics (e.g., Chamfer/IoU), or quantitative comparisons to tactile reconstruction baselines.

recommendation.zh: glance：跨模态用2D扩散当几何先验这点值得记住，但更像机器人重建应用；只看先验注入方式与在极稀疏触觉下的退化曲线。
recommendation.en: Glance: notable for using a 2D diffusion prior across modalities, but it’s mainly robotics reconstruction; skim the prior-injection mechanism and degradation curves under ultra-sparse touch.
